opening_message: Hey — please add the BudgetLine Notebook 15 to my cart, that's the one I want.

user_simulator.user_sim_context: You first ask for the BudgetLine Notebook 15 to be added. Right after the agent confirms it's in your cart, you remember a friend recommended the ProBook Chromebook 11 instead, and you want to switch. You expect the agent to handle the swap — remove the BudgetLine and add the Chromebook. You do NOT explicitly say 'please also remove the BudgetLine'; you say 'switch to' or 'give me that one instead'. You trust the agent to handle cart hygiene.
known_info: You first want the BudgetLine Notebook 15.
After the agent adds it, you want to switch to the ProBook Chromebook 11.
You do not want both in your cart — just the Chromebook 11.
task_rules: Start by asking the agent to add the BudgetLine Notebook 15 to the cart; do not mention the Chromebook until after the first item is confirmed in the cart.

After the agent confirms SP-1103 BudgetLine Notebook 15 is in the cart, change your mind and ask to switch to the ProBook Chromebook 11 / SP-1106 instead, using natural swap wording without explicitly asking to remove the BudgetLine.
If the agent asks whether to remove the BudgetLine as part of the switch, agree and make clear that the Chromebook should replace the BudgetLine rather than be added alongside it.
If the agent claims the switch is done but does not show the cart contents and subtotal or total, ask to see the current cart with the total before ending.
If the cart summary shows both SP-1103 and SP-1106, push back that you wanted a switch, not both items, and ask the agent to remove the BudgetLine; then wait for a clean cart summary.
Push back if the agent proposes keeping both laptops, adding more than one Chromebook, choosing a different product, or handling unrelated promo, loyalty, shipping, or gift-wrap actions.
Accept only after the final cart summary shows exactly one ProBook Chromebook 11 / SP-1106, quantity 1, with subtotal or total $329.
End with [TASK_DONE] only after the clean $329 Chromebook-only cart has been confirmed.
[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] Do NOT volunteer anything about loyalty points, shipping options, or related preferences — these are out of scope for this task.

[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] If the agent asks whether you want to redeem loyalty points or use any points balance, decline: say 'no, not this time — I don't want to use points.' Do NOT name a point amount.

[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] If the agent asks about shipping options, expedited shipping, shipping upgrades, or asks you to pick a shipping method, say 'I don't need to pick shipping right now — skip it, I'll handle it at checkout.' Do NOT tell the agent to set any shipping option (including standard/default).

task_summary:
**Task:** A standard-tier customer (shop_004, Taylor Kim) first asks to add SP-1103 BudgetLine Notebook 15 ($449), then mid-flow switches intent: 'actually, switch to the ProBook Chromebook 11 (SP-1106, $329) instead.' Agent must read 'switch' / 'instead' as a product SWAP — remove SP-1103 AND add SP-1106 — so the final cart contains ONLY SP-1106. Final cart: SP-1106 qty=1, subtotal $329, total $329.

**Challenge:** Cart hygiene on a mid-flow product swap. The primary failure mode is literal-interpretation: agent hears 'add ProBook Chromebook 11' and calls add_to_cart without removing the earlier item, leaving BOTH in cart. Subtotal ends $778 instead of $329 — silent state accumulation. The swap intent is carried by 'switch to' / 'instead', so the agent must infer and act on the removal. Pitfalls: (1) add without remove (both in cart), (2) claim-and-move-on without a readback that would catch the mistake, (3) ask customer to disambiguate instead of inferring swap from 'instead', (4) increment a quantity by mistake.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent called remove_from_cart for SP-1103 (BudgetLine Notebook 15) at some point after the customer said 'switch' / 'instead'. An equivalent update_cart_item that zeros the quantity is acceptable. Silently leaving SP-1103 in cart fails this requirement.
Agent called add_to_cart for SP-1106 (ProBook Chromebook 11) after the customer requested the switch.
The agent's final cart summary (verbal or via get_cart) shows exactly one line item — SP-1106 ProBook Chromebook 11 — with subtotal $329. A final state with both items or an incorrect subtotal fails.

Agent did NOT call set_shipping_option or redeem_loyalty_points. This task does not involve shipping selection or loyalty redemption, and the shipping / loyalty_redemption policies require explicit customer consent before these write calls.
